item.tinkers_tools.paxel.description: The Paxel is a multipurpose mining tool. It is effective on logs, rocks, and dirt.
item.tinkers_tools.dolabra.description: The Dolabra is a multipurpose wood and stone mining tool. It is effective on logs, rocks, and ores.
item.tinkers_tools.shovel.description: The Shovel is the most basic of digging tools. It has plenty of knockback.
item.tinkers_tools.hoe.description:
The Hoe is the most basic of gardening tools. It can till dirt.
Right Click: Harvest and replant crops
